ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Public Relations in the Digital Age This course will explore the role of new technologies in contemporary public relations, including social media networks, blogs, RSS feeds, and Wikis. Students will examine new technologies from the perspective of the key theories and models of public relations.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Speech Communication or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Media Studies or Communication or Media and Cinema Studies major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
